description: Takes no arguments and returns the business's service catalog sorted by name: count, truncated, and items, with at most 500 items. Each item has id, name, priceFromCents, priceToCents, unit, durationMin, isEmergency, and note. Prices are stored in cents; no currency, tax, or discount is implied. This Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only and reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:services on the consent screen. Results are JSON objects also returned as text; the limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.
name: neuron_services

truncated.description: True when the read stopped at its row cap (500; contact search 25).

title: List services
